name: Oketra's Monument
description: A legendary pyramid and sacred site on Amonkhet dedicated to the god Oketra, host of the Trial of Solidarity.

description_citations.text: "Oketra's Monument". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Initiates perform the Ascent at the wheat harvest, climbing the exterior stairs with burdens to present offerings to Oketra.
timeline.quote: Each year, Oketra is honored through an ancient rite known as the Ascent , performed at the wheat harvest.

citation.text: "Oketra's Monument", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Trial of Solidarity, Oketra looses a radiant arrow into the floor, the arena shifts, and waves of foes attack the initiates and their obelisk.
timeline.quote: Oketra appears on a balcony, drawing an arrow of radiant light from the orb crowning the pyramid.

citation.text: "Oketra's Monument", section "Trial of Solidarity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Initiates must split their efforts between retrieving the arrow and defending the obelisk to prove themselves worthy.
timeline.quote: Should the obelisk fall, the trial fails
